# The Next Gen Marketing Masters

## IMPACT Unveils the 3rd edition of CMO 40 Under 40 to honour the top minds shaping the future of Marketing. Check out the full winner list here

BY TEAM IMPACT Published: Jun 5, 2025 9:27 PM

The third edition of IMPACT’s CMO 40 Under 40 is back and this time, it’s grander than ever! After hours of debates and discussions between the jury comprising esteemed leaders of the industry, the top 40 have been selected to lead the way to the future of marketing. The list saw representation from distinguished achievers from across sectors. It put the spotlight on individuals who have made a significant impact with their groundbreaking work, shaping the industry’s landscape.The list saw a higher representation of women this year. Of the 40 marketing professionals selected, 23 are women and 17 are men—highlighting a positive shift toward gender balance in the industry. These individuals have made a significant impact with their groundbreaking work, shaping the future of marketing.The Consumer Durables sector had the highest representation, with seven winners, followed by FMCG and D2C, with six winners each. The list also featured five winners from BFSI, four from Retail, and three each from OTT and Digital Platforms. The E-commerce, Pharmaceutical & Healthcare, and Media & Entertainment sectors had two winners each.

BW Online Bureau Oct 12, 2022

Marketing is experiencing an overhaul where technology and digitisation are continually revolutionising the business landscape. As the sector gears up to meet challenges, real change is driven by growing talent and leadership. BW Marketing World shines the spotlight on 40 future masters whose strategies and consumer insight have pushed their brands and businesses forward in their growth trajectories.

The winners list was arrived at after a two-phased process concluding with the jury evaluation. The first phase invited entries from the Indian marketing and advertising fraternity. Following a pre-screening, a select number of entrants met the jury chaired by Naveen Soni, President, Lexus India.

# Vineet Edupuganti

## CEO at Cogent

## About Vineet Edupuganti

Vineet Edupuganti is the Co-Founder and CEO of Cogent Security, the company pioneering the world's first AI taskforce for vulnerability management. He was pivotal in scaling Abnormal AI from its earliest days to a market-leading security company, progressing from machine learning engineer to product leader, and later served as Head of the Multi-Product Platform Division. He holds both a bachelor's and master's degree from Stanford University. With a background in machine learning and product management, Vineet brings a product-first mindset to solving complex security challenges for modern enterprises. Cogent, founded in 2024, has raised $53 million to date — including an $11M seed from Greylock Partners and a $42M Series A led by Bain Capital Ventures.
